digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows and CI gate guards
propositions: The 'change predates the gate' shell guard appears 24 times across six workflow files with inconsistent application and two known drift defects (anxious-resistant-urson, sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly).
A shared guard implementation cannot be created because composite actions and repo-local helpers are absent on pre-gate trees, causing the guard to fail exactly where it is needed.
Four workflow sites carry side-effects (matrix output, independent generators, inverted conditionals, data-file guards) that a bare skip would silently drop and require special handling.
Gate reference and enablement resolution are already uniform across the four gates (plan-review close, plan-review claim, completion close, code-review) and consolidation would be pure indirection.

Every gate step in affected files must carry either an `-f` predates guard for its dependency or a mandatory-reason `# predates-gate-ok:` escape marker, enforced by test completeness and behaviour checks.
Two genuine gaps in guard coverage were discovered (test.yml golden-path and _optionality.yml degradation-path) and filed separately rather than fixed inline.
